note: Empirical null: the sampling distribution of the score with no signal present. Built by running the immutable reference strategy with no edge, pooling its per-session returns, and resampling N of them per draw. threshold_for()/far_for() read this table.

block_length_measurement.rule: first lag at which |acf| falls inside +/-1.96/sqrt(n), taken over returns and |returns|, whichever persists longer
